name: Lancaster Sensorimotor Norms: auditory, visual and haptic strength
source_citation: Lynott, D., Connell, L., Brysbaert, M., Brand, J., and Carney, J. (2020). The Lancaster Sensorimotor Norms: multidimensional measures of perceptual and action strength for 40,000 English words. Behavior Research Methods 52, 1271-1291. https://doi.org/10.3758/s13428-019-01316-z

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.scope: Original aggregate CSV words and ratings. Preserve author attribution, licence and adaptation notice. No third-party sentence or audio material is included.

grouping_rule: NFKC-normalized, stripped and casefolded original Word. All three target dimensions of a word share a group; the original input spelling is unchanged.
split_policy: Unassigned. Assign word groups jointly across all dimensions, for example 80/10/10. Audit morphological relatives and cross-source overlapping words before claiming unseen-word evaluation.
quality_findings: Only auditory, visual and haptic aggregate mean scores are selected. Other rating means, SDs, sample sizes and score-derived summary variables are excluded from input.
rating_sd and rating_n preserve source rater disagreement and sample size outside the prompt. They are not model prediction variance labels.
The OSF data node says the historical participant-ID correction affected trial-level data, not this aggregate file. Trial-level participant data are not included.
These are decontextualized human ratings across meanings of a word, not objective sensory measurements. References use 1-based data rows excluding the header.

auditory_strength.instruction: Estimate the mean human rating of how strongly the meaning of this English word is experienced through hearing. The scale ranges from 0 (not experienced at all) to 5 (experienced greatly).
auditory_strength.field_description: word is the original English word or expression, without sentence context. Ratings summarize people's experience of its meaning across possible senses; they are not a measurement of a physical property.

visual_strength.instruction: Estimate the mean human rating of how strongly the meaning of this English word is experienced through vision. The scale ranges from 0 (not experienced at all) to 5 (experienced greatly).
visual_strength.field_description: word is the original English word or expression, without sentence context. Ratings summarize people's experience of its meaning across possible senses; they are not a measurement of a physical property.

haptic_strength.instruction: Estimate the mean human rating of how strongly the meaning of this English word is experienced through touch. The scale ranges from 0 (not experienced at all) to 5 (experienced greatly).
haptic_strength.field_description: word is the original English word or expression, without sentence context. Ratings summarize people's experience of its meaning across possible senses; they are not a measurement of a physical property.
